answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after participants commit, using a domain-separated hash of the commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse as its unpredictable seed. Labels such as walnut, willow, and sable separate task domains without adding secret entropy. Since the pulse cannot be chosen or known in advance, automated sybil swarms cannot precompute valid responses or farm them offline; enrollment quotas still govern how many identities may compete.
